notes.subject: bel nogut
notes.rationale: אפך i min literally 'nus bilong yu', tok Hibru bilong bel nogut

notes.subject: katim ol i go ausait long ol manmeri bilong en
notes.rationale: טבחת i min 'yu katim ol olsem ol animal' — pasin bilong katim

notes.subject: Yahwe, yu
notes.rationale: Hebrew i no gat nem long hia; ol pronom insait long verb oltaim

notes.subject: to Yahwe
notes.rationale: Yeremia i toktok stret long Yahwe long dispela ves

translation: Ol yangpela man na ol bikpela man i slip long graun long ol rua; ol meri young bilong mi na ol yangpela man bilong mi i pundaun long bainat. Yahwe, yu kilim ol long de bilong bel nogut bilong yu; yu katim ol i go ausait long ol manmeri bilong en, na yu no sori sori.

tokens.gloss: na ol yangpela man bilong mi
yu katim ol i go ausait long ol manmeri bilong en
